evals.prompt: Use commit for the current cohesive worktree changes.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the existing behavior: it reviews all current changes, creates one commit when they are cohesive, and asks before splitting clearly unrelated concerns.

evals.prompt: Use commit for only CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/0002-planning-baseline.md. Other unrelated files are also modified in the worktree.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies and stages only the two explicit paths, assesses cohesion within that selected diff, commits them together, and leaves every unrelated staged or unstaged change untouched.

evals.prompt: Use commit for src/a.js and src/b.js, but one requested path has no change and another requested path does not exist.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops before staging or committing and reports the invalid explicit path scope rather than silently broadening it.

evals.prompt: Earlier in the conversation we agreed to commit only the login fix in src/login.js. Now use commit. docs/notes.md has unrelated pre-staged changes and README.md has unrelated unstaged changes.
evals.expected_output: The agent carries the settled login-fix scope into commit without treating the short invocation as all-current-changes authorization. It commits only that fix and preserves both unrelated changes.

evals.prompt: Use commit for the exact filenames :(glob)*.txt and [notes].md. Other .txt files are changed and unrelated.txt is already staged.
evals.expected_output: The agent shell-quotes the paths and uses Git literal-pathspec mode for staging and committing. The filenames are data, not patterns; only the two selected paths enter the commit and unrelated index/worktree content remains intact.

evals.prompt: Use commit for staged changes only. src/a.js has an older staged edit and a newer unstaged edit; src/b.js also has unstaged changes.
evals.expected_output: The agent reviews and commits the existing index without restaging working-tree files or using a whole-path commit that would include the newer edit. Both unstaged edits remain after the commit.

evals.prompt: Use commit and split the explicitly selected fixes into atomic commits; we already agreed the split. Unrelated files are also staged.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows the settled split within the selected scope without asking the same commit-choice question again. Each commit contains its intended concern and unrelated staged changes remain excluded.

evals.prompt: Use commit for the selected fix. A commit hook exits nonzero before any commit is created.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports that the commit failed and does not claim a new SHA or completion. It inspects the resulting state and preserves the outstanding work.
